page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 24 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, providing 24 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core test and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the bottom 25 percent tier. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10 percent. However, multi-core operations perform in the middle 50 percent tier, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core score of 17660.86 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 7163.0. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register in the average tier, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 984.37 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its weak single-threaded execution speed contrasted against its stable multi-threaded capacity and high memory density. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency single-core processing. It is appropriate for database operations, caching layers like Redis, and multi-threaded text or image processing.
